Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Kauai hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 15 Kauai hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 7, Agoda at 1, Hotelscombined.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Kauai rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Kauai hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 19% ($46 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Waipouli Beach Resort to 19% at The Westin Princeville Ocean Resort Villas. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
